faq.q: How is VIJ different from LinkedIn or Glassdoor?
faq.a: LinkedIn is a professional social network, and Glassdoor is a salary and review site. VIJ bridges both by using skill-centric career roadmaps, scenario simulation, and real-time community engagement to help you plan, transition, and land roles based on actual skills rather than generic bios.
Yes! VIJ respects privacy first. Users can customize public profiles, anonymize career stories, and manage who sees their roadmap data.

faq.q: How do I become a mentor?
faq.a: You can sign up as a Mentor in the Network tab, complete a profile detailing your skills and career history, and once verified by the community, start listing paid or unpaid booking slots.
Only if you set your visibility to 'Open to Opportunities'. You have full control over who can search or access your career roadmap.
Currently we support extensive mappings in Software Engineering, Data Science, Product Management, UI/UX Design, and Digital Marketing, with business management and other domains coming soon.

Yes, our core roadmap generator, job search, and community forums are 100% free with no ads or paywalls. Advanced AI tools and premium mentorship sessions are available under our Pro/Enterprise subscriptions.
